title: migration-report.json
description: The report of a migration to 31: the old and new versions, the hand edits made, the notices that need no edit, the choices the package was migrated with and each compared text. Reported, never a gate; like the other derived files it never lives in source.

handEdits.description: The hand edits made; [] for none.

notices.description: Every notice that needs no edit: a renamed id, a _macro suffix, a !x converted to blank(x), a suggestion, a reproducible claim that differed, the worst-case note; [] for none.

renames.description: Each hand-chosen rename, a 30 id to its 31 id; {} for none.

whenEmpty.description: Each deliverable's hand-chosen whenEmpty, by its id; {} for none (every deliverable release).

folderFormats.description: The format a snippet folder's items take, by the folder's id; {} for none (each folder <folder>_item).

options.description: The choices the package was migrated with: its options.json, beside its hand edits, as the migration read it.

site.description: The compared text's site: the file and place in it.

oldHash.description: The hash of the text at 30.

newHash.description: The hash of the text at 31.

equal.description: Whether the two texts are equal.

expected.description: Whether the rewrite declares and explains the difference.

explanation.description: Why the difference is expected; null unless expected is true.

texts.description: One entry per compared text; [] for none.
